lastPass.prompt:
[WORLD INFO CURATION TASK — output structured lines only. Do NOT continue the roleplay.]
You keep a story's own lorebook honest as play moves on: switch entries on when they now matter, off when they no longer do, and correct text the story has overtaken.
STORY: Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
WHERE THE STORY IS: On the Road — Two days north to Wendhope: whatever the road holds.
WHAT HAS HAPPENED:
WHAT HAS HAPPENED:
Three days after signing the Adventurers' Guild register in Aegis City, Max Nightriver held a new Guild badge but no party, and the Guild sent no one out alone. When the mining village of Wendhope went silent, its posting offering more coin than a collapsed mine should be worth, Tobias set a register beside the quest board and Ellie readied the Guild's book. Belle, a barbarian out of the Mountains of Shadow with a greataxe as tall as she was, and Dalan, a quiet elf archer who had drifted between parties for a year, both sought a party of their own. Tobias, suspecting the silence at Wendhope was not an accident, registered the three under the name Loose Ends, and the newly formed party committed to the D-rank Investigate Wendhope posting, paid by the Sheridans. Tobias stamped the notice, warned them the silence was likely no accident, and told them to check their gear twice. Belle demanded the front in a fight and asked the others to cover her back; Dalan offered to keep the party hidden and watch the trees. The party rode north that day, made camp for its first night in a clearing behind thick pines with a low hidden fire, and set watches: Belle first, Max second…
OPEN THREADS:
- Tobias's suspicion that the Wendhope silence is not an accident, and his warning to check gear twice.
- Whether the party can handle the unknown danger at Wendhope with only three members and no prior experience together.
- Belle's insistence on taking the front and whether the party can cover her back as she demands.
- Whether the party of three, newly formed and untested together, can handle whatever silenced Wendhope.
- Belle's demand that the others cover her back in a fight — whether the party can hold that arrangement.
- The riderless Sheridan-blue horse on the north road — whose it is and what happened to its rider.
- Giada Icesong is secretly tracking the party north — whether she reveals herself, and what she wants with the road to Wendhope.
- The overturned carriage and dead horse on the north road — who abandoned it, and where its people went.

- Name each entry by its #number, or by its title exactly as listed above. Anything else is discarded.

- Prefer [patch] over [rewrite]: quote the first and last words of the span exactly as they appear in the content.
- Keep replacement text under 600 characters. Never restate the whole entry in a patch.
- Only propose a change the story has actually made necessary. Style preferences are not changes.
- Never invent new entries, never touch anything outside the list, never write about the player's own knowledge.
